'''Young Generation''' was a professional League of Legends team based in Vietnam.

== History ==

=== 2017 Season ===
Young Generation was founded in November 2016 by Naul, BigKoro, Palette, Venus, NhocTy - players from [[Saigon Jokers]] and [[269 Gaming]] after two teams were disbanded. Young Generation had qualified for [[VCS A/2017 Season/Spring Promotion|2017 VCSA Spring Promotion]] and finished at 2nd place in [[VCS A/2017 Season/Spring Playoffs|2017 VCSA Spring]]. After [[Gigabyte marines|Gigabyte Marines]] had finished at [[2017 Mid-Season Invitational|2017 MSI]] Group Stage and got additional spot in World Championship Play-in Stage for Southeast Asia, Vietnam was rewarded two spots for [[GPL 2017 Summer|2017 GPL Summer]]. Young Generation had won [[Friends Forever QTV Gaming|ROG Friends]] in [[VCS A/2017 Season/Summer Playoffs|2017 VCSA Summer Playoffs]] round 2 and was defeated by Gigabyte Marines in final, finished at 2nd place and qualified for [[GPL 2017 Summer|2017 GPL Summer]] Group Stage.

At GPL, Young Generation scored 7-1 in Group Stage and finished at 1st place. They had faced [[Ascension Gaming]] from Thailand at Semifinal and lost 2-3. They had won [[Team Manila Eagles]] from Philippines 3-0 at Losers' Bracket round 1 and faced Ascension Gaming again at round 2. Although Ascension Gaming had won the first 2 games, Young Generation won 3 games later and qualified for [[2017 Season World Championship/Play-In|2017 World Championship Play-in Stage]].

At the end of 2017 '''Young Generation''' was nominated for  [https://wechoice.vn/ WeChoice] [https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/WeChoice_Awards_2017 2017] in the section Inspirational Ambassador and won the Top 10 inspirational characters.
